jobs.title: Federal Court Security & Patrol Specialist
jobs.description:
United States Marshals Service seeks a Court Security Officer (CSO) to protect federal court facilities and personnel under a USMS contract. The CSO operates under supervision, performing fixed-post, mobile, or foot patrols with strict adherence to post orders and facility rules.

Responsibilities include enforcing entry systems, escorting individuals, surveillance of entrances, and potential courtroom security.

jobs.description:
